text:
neha: Quick report from a fresh run of the starter-kit sampleapp: onboarding prefill fires 5 parallel page pulls and we see a tight window where token refresh fails for ~1s. That causes retries to pile up and the client opens its circuit. New devs hitting this during first-run think the API is down.

owen: Ugh, start-up friction. Which SDK + sample?

neha: ts-starter-kit (node-sdk 0.13.2). Defaults: PREFETCH_PAGES=5, PREFETCH_PARALLEL=5, PAGE_SIZE=20, REFRESH_BEFORE=10s.

rafa: Can you paste the short config and a tiny log slice?

neha: Config (env):
```
PREFETCH_PAGES=5
PREFETCH_PARALLEL=5
PAGE_SIZE=20
REFRESH_BEFORE=10
```
Log snippet: 
```
2026-03-24T11:05:01Z INFO prefill start pages=5 parallel=5
2026-03-24T11:05:02Z WARN http 429 route=/responses
2026-03-24T11:05:02Z INFO token: refresh kick
2026-03-24T11:05:03Z ERROR token refresh 502
2026-03-24T11:05:04Z WARN retry attempt=1 route=/responses
2026-03-24T11:05:05Z ERROR client circuit open
```
This is reproducible in staging when the OIDC provider injects occasional 502s.

marta: Is this JS-only? Any parity gaps?

owen: We looked at retries recently. node-sdk uses deterministic backoff (base=400ms, factor=2, no jitter). rust-sdk and go-sdk implemented "full jitter" already. So N parallel prefetches -> aligned retries -> thundering herd.

rafa: Also saw that paginator re-enqueues a page on retry without dedupe id, which causes duplicate processing when a retry wins. That duplicates downstream work.

neha: Right. For a short-term mitigation I set PREFETCH_PAGES=2 and PREFETCH_PARALLEL=1 in the starter-kit and onboarding now completes cleanly. But that's a poor first-impression.

marta: Proposal: (A) add jitter to node retry backoff (parity), (B) change starter-kit defaults to conservative values, (C) add a prefill-mode env: SEQUENTIAL|PARALLEL with default SEQUENTIAL for first-run, (D) add idempotency keys for page fetches.

owen: Also suggest telemetry: emit event onboard.prefill.error with tags {sdk:node, prefetch:5, parallel:5} so we can alert SLO/UX. And a UX tip: show an inline toast: "Prefill paused due to transient auth error; retrying with reduced parallelism".

rafa: I'll own a tiny PR that: 1) implements jitter in node retry (small patch), 2) debounce/serialize the first-run prefill, and 3) add a dedupe map keyed by page-id.

neha: Awesome. Can we also add a sample env alias in README: "If onboarding fails, set PREFETCH_PAGES=2"? New users rarely look at issues.

marta: Long-term: consider client-side adaptive gating: observe 429/502 rate in last Xs and progressively reduce concurrency/prefetch. Might be a neat Optimize feature later.

ci-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: starter-kit v0.6.0 canary @ 2026-03-24T15:00Z.

owen: Thanks team. Rafael, ping back when PR is up and I'll add SDK parity label.

neha: I'll attach a tiny repro gist after the meeting for folks who want to run locally.

marta: Great catch; this is a high-visibility DX issue.

rafa: PR opened: github.com/redwood/samples/pull/412 with jitter + serial prefill + dedupe. I'll link once CI green.
